The rock surface is gray and textured with vertical striations and cracks. The right side of the image fades into a hazy, blue-gray background, suggesting depth or atmospheric mist.

The leaves show slight inconsistency in focus; some edges are sharp while adjacent leaves melt into each other, typical of AI generation struggling with complex organic overlapping structures.
